levelZeroRule: Level 0 always means the thing is missing or broken. Where a gate covers the failure, level 0 is the gate. A criterion lists a level 0 only where the plan does.

gates.name: Unreachable control
gates.failsWhen: A front-face control is clipped, hidden, overlapped, or outside the card at any size and fixture inside the envelope.

gates.name: Clipped content
gates.failsWhen: Text or content overflows the card or is cut mid-glyph without a scroll container, at any size and fixture inside the envelope.

gates.name: Runtime errors
gates.failsWhen: A console error or crash while adding, resizing, configuring, minimizing/maximizing or reloading the widget.

gates.name: Data leak or loss
gates.failsWhen: Content follows the widget type to another board, teacher content is lost on reload, or protected student data (R4) is on the projected face by default.

criteria.name: Small size
criteria.methodNotes: Script: controls in bounds, hit areas, text sizes at the envelope minimum. Judge: did the widget choose what to keep.

descriptors.0: Gate G1 or G2 fails at the minimum size.
descriptors.1: Everything fits but has shrunk uniformly to the point of being unreadable or untappable.
descriptors.2: Readable and usable, but secondary content crowds the primary content.
descriptors.3: Secondary content collapses, hides or moves into an overflow so the primary content stays dominant and readable.
descriptors.4: The small layout is a deliberate design of its own (a compact mode) that a teacher would choose on purpose.

criteria.name: Large size
criteria.methodNotes: Script: fraction of card area occupied by content, size of the primary element. Judge: proportion and value of the large layout.

descriptors.1: Content stays at its default size in a corner or the middle, leaving most of the card empty.
descriptors.2: Content grows, but proportions break: stretched controls, giant gaps, or lines too long to read.
descriptors.3: Content grows proportionally and fills the card; line lengths stay readable.
descriptors.4: The large layout adds value, such as showing more items or detail, rather than only zooming.

criteria.name: Aspect ratio
criteria.methodNotes: Script: dead band area at the widest and tallest aspect. Judge: reflow and fit to shape.

descriptors.1: One layout at every aspect ratio; wide or tall shapes leave large dead bands.
descriptors.2: Content centers sensibly but does not reflow.
descriptors.3: Layout reflows between row and column arrangements at the extremes of the envelope.
descriptors.4: Each aspect ratio looks designed for that shape.

criteria.name: Scaling technique

applicability.rule: Applies to all widgets. Widgets on container-query scaling (skipScaling: true) are scored on the levels below; widgets that keep transform: scale() (drawing, seating-chart, sticker) are scored on whether that choice is still justified.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: static scan of the front-face files for fixed Tailwind text, width, gap and padding classes and fixed icon size props.

descriptors.1: The front face mostly uses fixed sizes.
descriptors.2: Mixed: primary content scales, many secondary elements are fixed.
descriptors.3: All front-face sizing uses cqmin / min() / clamp() per components/widgets/CLAUDE.md; a few justified exceptions.
descriptors.4: Fully compliant, with sizes following the hero/secondary/tertiary targets in components/widgets/CLAUDE.md.

criteria.name: Projector legibility
criteria.methodNotes: Script: computed font sizes and contrast at default size, R16 thresholds.

descriptors.1: Primary content under 24 px or text contrast under 3:1.
descriptors.2: Primary content meets the threshold; some readable text under 14 px or under 4.5:1.
descriptors.3: All thresholds met.
descriptors.4: Thresholds met at the envelope minimum too, and the primary content is readable from across a room (≥36 px at default size).

criteria.name: Scrolling

applicability.rule: Applies when any fixture produces scrollable content.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: nested scroll containers, end padding per tests/e2e/helpers/scrollEndPadding.ts, whole-card scroll.

descriptors.1: The whole card scrolls, or scrollbars nest.
descriptors.2: One scroller, but its last item sits flush against the bottom edge or the scroller sits under fixed content.
descriptors.3: Scrolling is confined to the content list, keeps end padding, and fixed controls stay visible.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the widget avoids scrolling at default size with typical content by adapting density.

criteria.name: Size envelope
criteria.methodNotes: Judge, against the widget's purpose and the global 150×100 floor.

descriptors.1: The minimum size is set higher than the content needs, so small-size problems never get tested.
descriptors.2: The minimum is somewhat higher than the content needs.
descriptors.3: The envelope matches what the content genuinely needs.
descriptors.4: The widget works below what one would expect for its content.

criteria.name: Maximized / presenting
criteria.methodNotes: Script: maximized render. Judge: whether it reads as a presenting layout.

descriptors.1: Maximized is the default layout stretched, with the S2 level-1 problems.
descriptors.2: Fills the screen but looks like an enlarged card.
descriptors.3: Looks intentional at full screen: type and spacing suit presenting.
descriptors.4: Maximized is a real presentation mode, with layout or detail changes made for presenting.

criteria.name: Drag surface
criteria.methodNotes: Script: fraction of the card where a pointer-down starts a drag at default size; whether the inner edge strips are covered by no-drag elements.

descriptors.1: Under 15% of the card is grabbable, or the inner edge strips are covered.
descriptors.2: 15–35% grabbable; edge strips free.
descriptors.3: 35–60% grabbable, with an obvious grab area.
descriptors.4: Over 60% grabbable, with no accidental drags from controls.

criteria.name: Touch targets

applicability.rule: Applies when the front face has controls.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: hit-area sizes per R16.

descriptors.1: Most controls under 32 px at default size.
descriptors.2: Some controls under 44 px at default size.
descriptors.3: All ≥44 px at default size and ≥32 px at the envelope minimum.
descriptors.4: As 3, with spacing between adjacent targets (≥8 px) so a finger cannot hit two at once.

criteria.name: Finger-friendly

applicability.rule: Applies when the front face has controls.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: controls revealed only on :hover, required double-clicks, small drag targets. Judge: whether core actions work with a single finger.

descriptors.1: A core action needs hover or a precise drag.
descriptors.2: Secondary actions are hover-only.
descriptors.3: Everything works with a single finger tap; nothing needs hover.
descriptors.4: Large-panel gestures where they help (swipe, long-press) with tap fallbacks.

criteria.name: Keyboard and screen reader

applicability.rule: Applies when the front face has controls.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: axe run, tab order, visible focus, accessible names.

descriptors.1: Controls unreachable by keyboard or unnamed.
descriptors.2: Reachable, but focus invisible or tab order illogical; axe violations.
descriptors.3: No axe violations; logical order; visible focus.
descriptors.4: As 3, with useful shortcuts or live-region announcements for changing values.

criteria.name: Reduced motion
criteria.methodNotes: Script: animations under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

descriptors.1: Looping animation ignores reduced motion.
descriptors.3: Every looping or large motion has a motion-reduce: guard.
descriptors.4: Reduced-motion mode is designed, not just disabled.

criteria.name: Feedback

applicability.rule: Applies when the front face has controls.

criteria.methodNotes: Judge: screenshots of pressed, active and selected states.

descriptors.1: Controls show no state change.
descriptors.2: Some controls lack pressed or active states.
descriptors.3: Every control shows hover/pressed/active/selected states consistent with shared components.
descriptors.4: As 3, with feedback for slow actions (pending state) and success.

criteria.name: Toolbar
criteria.methodNotes: Script: overlap between the floating toolbar and front-face controls when selected.

descriptors.1: The toolbar covers a primary control.
descriptors.2: The toolbar covers secondary controls at some sizes.
descriptors.3: No overlap at any size in the envelope.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the widget's own controls do not duplicate toolbar actions.

criteria.name: Modern appearance
criteria.methodNotes: Judge, against Paul's exemplar widgets for each level and the ban list.

descriptors.1: Three or more ban-list hits; reads as 2005.
descriptors.2: One or two ban-list hits, or clean but dated.
descriptors.3: No ban-list hits; matches the level-3 exemplar.
descriptors.4: Matches the level-4 exemplar: confident type, restraint, glass look per components/CLAUDE.md.

banList: heavy gradients, bevels, drop shadows on everything
default browser controls on the front face
every element boxed in a border
crowded rows of pills or chips

criteria.name: Clutter
criteria.methodNotes: Script proxies at default size with the typical fixture (visible controls, distinct font sizes, distinct colors, words, borders and boxes), plus Judge: a 3-second test (can the purpose and primary action be named at a glance from the back of the room) and a holistic busy-ness rating. Proxy thresholds are set from the first full sweep.

descriptors.1: Fails the 3-second test; proxies far over threshold.
descriptors.2: Passes the 3-second test but proxies over threshold.
descriptors.3: Passes; proxies within threshold.
descriptors.4: Passes; nothing on the face could be removed without losing function.

criteria.name: Hierarchy
criteria.methodNotes: Judge.

descriptors.1: No primary element; everything competes.
descriptors.2: A primary element exists but secondary elements are equally heavy.
descriptors.3: One clear primary element; secondary and tertiary elements step down in size and weight.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the eye path matches the order a teacher uses it.

criteria.name: Consistency
criteria.methodNotes: Script: imports of shared components for buttons, inputs, selects, empty states, drawer sections; one-off color and radius values. Judge: overall consistency.

descriptors.1: Mostly one-off controls and styling.
descriptors.2: Shared components in the drawer, one-off styling on the face.
descriptors.3: Shared components and tokens throughout; few one-offs.
descriptors.4: No one-offs; anything new was added to the shared set.

criteria.name: Theming
criteria.methodNotes: Script: base background transparent; global transparency, font and window radius honored; standard appearance keys used and wired.

descriptors.1: Ignores global style settings.
descriptors.2: Honors some global settings; non-standard appearance keys.
descriptors.3: Honors every global setting; uses the standard appearance controls and keys.
descriptors.4: As 3, and looks good across the full range of transparency and surface colors.

criteria.name: Icons and copy
criteria.methodNotes: Script: tests/copyGuard.test.ts rules, icon library use. Judge: wording.

descriptors.1: Copy guard violations or mixed icon styles.
descriptors.2: Compliant but wordy or unclear labels.
descriptors.3: Short, plain labels; one icon style.
descriptors.4: Labels a teacher would write; icons need no label to be understood where used alone.

criteria.name: Coverage
criteria.methodNotes: Judge: list every hardcoded content, structure or visual choice on the face; decide which a teacher would plausibly vary.

descriptors.1: Structure and content are hardcoded; settings cover little.
descriptors.2: Main choices configurable; notable plausible ones hardcoded, or settings bloated with choices nobody needs.
descriptors.3: Every plausible choice is configurable; no bloat.
descriptors.4: As 3, and settings anticipate classroom variants (grade level, multiple sections, sub use).

criteria.name: Drawer organization

applicability.rule: Applies when the widget has settings.

criteria.methodNotes: Judge: drawer screenshots. Script: drawer schema renders, scroll end padding.

descriptors.1: One long unordered list.
descriptors.2: Grouped, but advanced options mixed in with common ones.
descriptors.3: Common settings first, advanced ones collapsed; standard sections and controls.
descriptors.4: As 3, and a teacher finds any setting in one look.

criteria.name: Zero-config defaults
criteria.methodNotes: Judge: the empty fixture and the default config.

descriptors.1: Unusable until configured.
descriptors.2: Usable but defaults look unfinished.
descriptors.3: Defaults produce a useful, good-looking widget.
descriptors.4: Defaults adapt to context (class, grade level, time of day) where it makes sense.

criteria.name: No dead controls

applicability.rule: Applies when the widget has settings.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: toggle each setting in the harness and diff the rendered face.

descriptors.0: A setting changes nothing visible or behavioral.
descriptors.3: Every setting has an effect.
descriptors.4: As 3, and settings that only apply in some modes are hidden in the others.

criteria.name: First-use clarity
criteria.methodNotes: Judge: the empty fixture at default size.

descriptors.1: A blank or confusing face on first drop.
descriptors.2: An empty state exists but does not say what to do next.
descriptors.3: ScaledEmptyState with a title, at most one sentence, and a clear next action.
descriptors.4: The next action can be done right on the face, or the controls themselves are the empty state (such as lamps to tap).

criteria.name: Live settings preview

applicability.rule: Applies when the widget has settings.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: change a setting with the drawer open; check the face updates without closing the drawer.

descriptors.1: Changes show only after closing or saving.
descriptors.3: Every change shows on the face immediately.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the drawer never covers the part of the widget being changed.

criteria.name: States
criteria.methodNotes: Script: forced loading, error, offline and no-roster states in the harness. Judge: quality of each designed view.

descriptors.1: Raw errors, blank cards or infinite spinners.
descriptors.2: Some states designed.
descriptors.3: Every reachable state has a designed view using shared components.
descriptors.4: As 3, with recovery actions (retry, reconnect, pick a class).

criteria.name: Data safety

applicability.rule: Applies to widgets that hold teacher content.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: reload keeps content; a second board does not inherit content; destructive actions confirm or undo.

descriptors.1: Destructive actions are instant and unrecoverable.
descriptors.3: Content persists, stays per-board, and destructive actions confirm or support undo.
descriptors.4: As 3, and integrates with the toolbar undo.

criteria.name: Performance
criteria.methodNotes: Script: React Profiler in the harness.

descriptors.1: Two or more budgets missed.
descriptors.2: One budget missed.
descriptors.3: All budgets met.
descriptors.4: As 3, with headroom of at least 25% on chunk size and no work at all when off-screen or minimized.

budgets: zero re-renders while a neighboring widget is dragged
no timers faster than 1 s unless something visibly animates
at most one Firestore listener per instance, removed on unmount
resize settles within one frame without layout thrash
lazy chunk within its per-widget budget (set from the baseline at build time)

criteria.name: Student privacy on screen

applicability.rule: Applies when the widget can display roster or response data.

criteria.methodNotes: Script: protected fields in the face DOM under the typical fixture. Judge: reveal design. Names are fine where they are the point (pickers, groups, seating).

descriptors.2: Protected data is hidden by default but reveals with one accidental tap.
descriptors.3: Protected data lives in the drawer or behind an explicit teacher reveal.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the revealed state is visibly marked so a teacher notices it before projecting.

criteria.name: Multi-instance
criteria.methodNotes: Script: two instances on one harness board, each configured differently.

descriptors.1: Instances share state or one breaks the other.
descriptors.2: Independent, but Nexus links or partner lookups pick the wrong instance.
descriptors.3: Fully independent; Nexus lets the teacher choose the partner.
descriptors.4: As 3, and the widget makes multiple instances useful (labels, color coding).

criteria.name: Nexus

applicability.rule: Applies to all widgets; scored against docs/nexus.md and its Value + Feasibility − Coupling method.

criteria.methodNotes: Judge. Output always includes a proposal list (add, remove) for Paul; loops act on neither (R14).

descriptors.1: Existing connections misfire or add settings noise; obvious high-value connections missing.
descriptors.2: Connections work; one or more high-value candidates missing.
descriptors.3: All high-value connections present and discoverable; none that only add noise.
descriptors.4: As 3, and connections show their state on the face (what this widget is linked to).

criteria.name: Help and tour coverage
criteria.methodNotes: Script: a Help Center article exists for the widget; key controls carry registered data-tour anchors from config/tourAnchors.ts.

descriptors.1: Neither.
descriptors.2: One of the two.
descriptors.3: Article plus anchors on every primary control.
descriptors.4: As 3, plus a live tour.

criteria.name: Code health
criteria.methodNotes: Script: tests exist for the widget folder, file sizes, any count, architecture rules (canvas store not useDashboard() on the hot path, no derived-state useEffect). Judge: overall.

descriptors.1: No tests; architecture rule violations.
descriptors.2: Some tests; large files or violations.
descriptors.3: Tests for main behavior; no violations; files of reasonable size.
descriptors.4: As 3, and fixtures and harness coverage make the widget safe for an agent to change.
